notes.title: Version 2.0 Available Now!
notes.content: [h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32097946/0cd7847341e63ff56a9b347d1be566baa7baa1df.png"][/img][/h2][p][/p][p]Okay, so if you are wondering why this big update exists, please read our [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/792040/view/499455091736052662?l=english"]previous post[/url].[/p][p][/p][p]TLDR: I've wanted to bring the Steam version of [i][b]Detective Di: The Silk Rose Murders[/b][/i] up-to-date for a while now, but given the size of our team (mostly me!), those changes have taken longer than expected.[/p][p][/p][p]But, that changes today! Version 2.0 is live and downloadable now. With it, you'll see improvements in many areas. And while these changes do not impact the story or the core gameplay, I do think they enhance the overall experience for different devices and screens (hello Steam Deck!). In other words: this is the latest and greatest![/p][p][/p][p]Here's a list of the major changes and improvements:[/p][list][*][p]new UI/UX for the "Inventory Bar"[/p][/*][*][p]new drag-and-drop functionality when using/combining inventory items[/p][/*][*][p]new "Detective Vision" button which reveals on-screen hotspots[/p][/*][*][p]new auto-save system; triggered at key points in the game[/p][/*][*][p]new location markers on "Map" screen[/p][/*][*][p]improved UI for readability on smaller screens[/p][/*][*][p]hard drive space requirement reduced by ~50%[/p][/*][*][p]fixed some minor bugs[/p][/*][*][p]fixed a couple of typos[/p][/*][*][p]and many more small tweaks[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]In other news: The Silk Rose Murders Book Adaptation Kickstarter is Live![/h2][p][/p][p]It's happening: The [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/nupixo/the-silk-rose-murders-a-young-judge-dee-mystery-a-novel"][u]new Kickstarter campaign[/u][/url] to reimagine [i][b]The Silk Rose Murders [/b][/i]as a[b] novel[/b] has just launched! Read more about this exciting project and how it continues the Detective Di saga in [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/792040/view/499456994710651650"]this post[/url].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32097946/4ea1ddbbb2530406837856ac98a005b16a6986b7.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your support![/p][p]Minh[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: The Silk Rose Murders Book Adaptation — New Kickstarter is Live!
notes.content:
[p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32097946/4ea1ddbbb2530406837856ac98a005b16a6986b7.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]It's happening: The [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/nupixo/the-silk-rose-murders-a-young-judge-dee-mystery-a-novel"][u]new Kickstarter campaign[/u][/url] to reimagine [b][i]The Silk Rose Murders [/i][/b]as a[b] novel [/b]has just launched![/h3][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]This is something that I've been wanting to do for a while. In fact, it has long been my ambition to make this story and its characters as accessible as possible. But beyond that, I think I have more stories to tell in this unique saga—and this would be a perfect launching pad to make that a reality![/p][p][/p][p align="start"]I hope you'll help me recapture that magic that made the game (and the first Kickstarter) a success. But critically, I also believe that, as a novel, [b][i]The Silk Rose Murders[/i][/b] will shine in ways that will be moving and unexpected.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]So, please check out the campaign and find out more about what the novel will bring to the table. And don't forget to check out what I have in store for the [u][url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/nupixo/the-silk-rose-murders-a-young-judge-dee-mystery-a-novel"]next Judge Dee adventure[/url][/u]! (Hint: [b][i]The Midnight Kingdom[/i][/b])[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32097946/2ea8358078e6ef3ed3facde3e5928ae2bbc72cb5.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Warm regards,
Minh[/p]

notes.title: Version 2.0 Coming Soon + The Silk Rose Murders Novel
notes.content: [p]Hello again everyone![/p][p][/p][p]It's so great to have a chance to reach out to you guys and gals once more. And with super exciting news no less! I know it's been a while since our last announcement, but this one is a big one: [b][i]Detective Di: The Silk Rose Murders[/i] version 2.0 is coming in just a couple of weeks.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32097946/21ba51c2c624051b1cfd4b70e6522e4c3d2955b3.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]So, I know what you're asking: "What the heck is in 2.0? And why did it take so long to release?"[/p][p][/p][p]For those of you who have followed the journey of this project since its Kickstarter origins, you may know that after the original release on Steam in English and Chinese, we ported the game to multiple platforms, including Nintendo and Xbox. Since then, the game was even translated to Korean for an exclusive release in that region.[/p][p][/p][p]This process took many years, and over time, we made small incremental updates and improvements along the way. Given the size of our team (mostly me!), those changes were never back-ported to the Steam version. Well, that changes soon![/p][p][/p][p]While these changes do not impact the story or the core gameplay, I do think they enhance the overall experience for different devices and screens (hello Steam Deck!). In other words, we think the current version is great, but this one is even better![/p][p][/p][p]So then, here are a few highlights of v2.0:[/p][list][*][p]new drag-and-drop functionality when using/combining inventory items[/p][/*][*][p]new "Detective Vision" button which reveals on-screen hotspots[/p][/*][*][p]new auto-save system; triggered at key points in the game[/p][/*][*][p]and much more! (We'll publish the full list when the update is live.)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]But wait! There's something else: [b]Detective Di is crossing over to the printed page—[url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/nupixo/the-silk-rose-murders-a-young-judge-dee-mystery-a-novel"]new Kickstarter September 1st[/url]![/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Yes! I’m bringing the game's story to a brand-new medium: [b]the novel[/b]. This September, [b]I’m launching a Kickstarter to adapt[/b] [i][b]The Silk Rose Murders[/b][/i][b] from game to book[/b]. I’d love for you to join me on this next chapter of Detective Di's journey![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32097946/0b40eaf60544ac39085f4add918134c16f6cf1bf.png"][/img][/p][p][url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/nupixo/the-silk-rose-murders-a-young-judge-dee-mystery-a-novel"]Check out our pre-launch page to learn more[/url] and see how this affects [b]my plans for a sequel[/b]! Remember to hit the "Notify Me" button so you don’t miss launch day![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your support![/p][p]Minh[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Detective Di Celebrates 2-Year Anniversary... What's Next?
notes.content:
It is with great pride, humility, and gratitude that we mark the 2-year anniversary of the release of Detective Di: The Silk Rose Murders. To celebrate, the game will be on sale at 60% off until the end of this month.

We want to thank each person who has given our little indie game a chance. It is your continued support and encouragement that has allowed our game to carve out a tiny corner of the vast gaming universe. The fact that you continue to wishlist, buy, and share your thoughts on our game is enough to fill our hearts with even greater hopes and dreams.

Of course, as a creator, it can be scary to talk about those hopes and dreams. To put yourself and your ideas out into the world is an intimidating endeavor. But, making indie games is nothing if not bold!

So, having said that, I give you this little nugget (think marathon, not sprint):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32097946/6405e4e4b4eeb0b114309aaa5cfc3ea49913d453.png[/img]

notes.title: Detective Di: The Silk Rose Murders Nominated for 4 Aggie Awards
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32097946/4a1c09f0cb7c6b2a9d46f3ec465286d292cbf7e6.png[/img]

Every year, [b]Adventure Gamers[/b], one of the oldest and most respected websites covering adventure games, announces its nominees for the best adventure games of the past year in 15 different categories.

For 2019, there where 180 games in contention for nominations. Yesterday, AG revealed its highly anticipated list of nominees for 14 of the 15 awards -- reserving the final award, Best Adventure, for a final reveal during the announcement of the winners on February 7th, 2020.

We are extremely honored and thankful that [b]Detective Di: The Silk Rose Murders[/b] is on this prestigious list of games.

Without further ado, here are the nominations:

• Best Story
• Best Writing - Drama
• Best Setting
• Best Traditional Adventure

Here's a link to the full article: https://adventuregamers.com/articles/view/39492

It means a great deal to us that such a publication has recognized our hard work, and we want to once again thank all the folks that have offered their support since the inception of this little indie game idea -- and ultimately helped it become a reality. Thank you all so much and good luck to all the nominees!

notes.title: Steam Cloud + Chapters Menu (v1.3.1)
notes.content:
[b]Steam Cloud Saving Added[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32097946/940ab27e6cd3c19a67d05da8af9c70f208372470.png[/img]
 
This latest update adds Steam Cloud support for Detective Di: The Silk Rose Murders (PC and Mac).
 
Once you open the game after updating to v1.3.1, all your saves will be transferred to Steam’s cloud save system. If you have synchronization enabled, this means your saves will stay on Steam's servers as long as you are connected to your account.
 
[b]Official Support for Chapters Menu[/b]
 
Previously available only for testers and the development team, we also added the highly-requested "Chapters" menu. This allows players to jump back to the start of any chapter they choose. Players who finished the game prior to updating to v1.3.1 can also access this feature.
 
All players can now open this menu by accessing the "Main" menu or the in-game "Pause" menu. From one of those menus, open the "Load" menu. Then, press "j" on your keyboard to open the "Chapters" menu.
 
Have fun!

notes.title: Detective Di: The Silk Rose Murders will put players on the hunt for an ancient serial killer in May
notes.content:
Upcoming point and click adventure game Detective Di: The Silk Rose Murders takes players all the way back to imperial China, where there s a serial killer to be caught. The good detective must investigate for clues, solve puzzles, and re-enact crimes according to his theories in order to figure out what happened and eventually track down the murderer. And, according to the trailer below, play a few rounds of Go while they’re at it.
